what: just qc and the code review run in parallel on the same integrated head H; the review verdict names H, not the qc status head H'; the merge ask names H' and both verdicts, and a check proves H to H' changes only the status files. A clean merge of main keeps the qc verdict when a check proves the lane's own diff is unchanged; the merge ask names the judged head, the refreshed head and the proof. why: Owner ruling, issue #67 items 1, 9 and 10 (Tom, 2026-10-21): QC is every check on what ships; the code reviewer does code quality only; qc and review must not wait on each other, and a clean main refresh must not rerun the judge. Marked weakens because the review verdict no longer names the exact merge head; the status-only check carries that guarantee instead.
evidence: Two contradicting lines once this PR lands: docs/adr/0022 (corrected in place, issue #67 item 9: integrate, then qc and review in parallel, then the merge ask) and agents/qc-judge.md (the judge's own role, item 1) against issue-lifecycle#lanes-one-head 'its status-only commit is the head the fresh code review then judges' and #acceptance-qc-interim 'from a code reviewer started fresh'.
